Exhibit E: MXD District Open Space Substitutions for
Constructing Pedestrian Ways
Pedestrian Way
For each lineal foot of pedestrian way provided, the following amounts of open space may be deducted from the lot's open space requirement
Open Pedescrian Bridge
30 sq. ft.
Raised Pedestrian Deck
50 sq. ft.

40 sq. ft.
Elevated Shopping Bridge
120 sq. ft.
